Struct MaybeNoteMessage

pub struct MaybeNoteMessage<Note>
{ /* private fields */ }

Same as [NewNoteMessage], except this type also handles the possibility where the note may not have been actually created depending on runtime conditions (e.g. a token transfer change note is not created if there is no change). Other than that, it and [MaybeNoteMessage::delivery] behave the exact same way as [NewNoteMessage].

 pub fn deliver(self, recipient: AztecAddress, delivery_mode: u8)
where Note: NoteType, Note: Packable

Same as [NewNoteMessage::deliver], except the message will only be delivered if it actually exists.

Messages delivered using crate::messages::message_delivery::MessageDeliveryEnum::CONSTRAINED_ONCHAIN will pay proving costs regardless of whether the message exists or not.
